description:
stellotech is a team of passionate freshers eager to take on the NASA Space Apps Challenge! While we are new to hackathons, we are excited to learn, collaborate, and apply our foundational skills in coding, design, and problem-solving to build a creative solution

We are passionate innovators and enthusiastic learners who come together to turn extraordinary ideas into reality. With teamwork, creativity, and determination, we explore new possibilities, overcome challenges, and aim for excellence
